description: Runs one card from a start state through segments of steps, each under its own load, and seals the run. The answer holds the outcome, the final state in decimals and exact hex, a frame for each recorded step, the run_seal and a receipt. record_every sets which steps are recorded, about 262 characters each; the final state comes back in full whatever is recorded. readout gives named quantities in decimals without the frames, with each one's minimum and maximum over every landed step and the first step past a level; it is not part of the sealed request. from starts the run from a sealed run, which is computed again first. A run comes back in one of four ways. outcome "completed": every step landed. outcome "ended": the run reached an end its card declares, which describe_card lists under declared_ends; reject holds the end's name. outcome "refused": a step part way was refused; reject holds the name (null when the cause has none) and reject_detail the sentence. An ended or a refused run is sealed up to its last landed step, steps_landed. An error, not a result: the request was turned away before computing, in one sentence with the refusal's name in round brackets when it has one, and nothing is sealed. A sentence that begins "Physical Failure" says the state asked for or reached is outside the card; one that begins "Physical Violation" says the request, or a number in it or computed from it, is not one the engine takes. A load may be signed; load_source says by whom. On this open connection one address holds at most 1 physics permit at a time; a call that finds none is answered "Too many concurrent physics tasks." and nothing waits. An answer is waited for 60 seconds, and long work is stopped there.

inputSchema.description: One anchored run. Total steps must be <= 1000000. Recorded frames must be <= 10000. The shape of initial and of each segment's load depends on the pair: describe_card gives it. A request turned away before computing is an error of one sentence, with the refusal's name in round brackets when it has one, and nothing is sealed. A run refused part way is a result: outcome "refused", reject the name, reject_detail the sentence, sealed to steps_landed. A run that reaches an end its card declares has outcome "ended" and reject the end's name. A required key left out is named InputMissing, and a card the engine does not serve UnknownCard.

card.description: The card of the pair, as list_cards names it.

domain.description: The domain of the pair, as list_cards names it.

dt_s.description: Step, in seconds. Held for the whole run.

from.description: Optional: start from a sealed run. request: that run_trajectory request as sent, less its readout if it had one: a readout is not part of a run's seal, and a request here that carries one is refused (it may hold its own from); run_seal: its seal; coupling: absent to continue the same card (describe_card says how), or a coupling's name. The upstream is computed again; each carried value must equal its sealed value bit for bit, and a request whose upstream seal or carried value does not hold is refused by name. The run_seal is that of this request without from; chain.chain_seal commits it to the upstream.

initial.description: The phase fields of the card at the start of the run, each a number (a vector field is an array of three numbers), and no other key but signed: an instrument's signature over the rest of initial, under the key "initial", by the rule of a segment's signed. describe_card gives the fields, with each unit and bound.

readout.description: Optional. Reads quantities without the frames: {"quantities": [names the card publishes], "first_past": {"quantity": <one of them>, "above" or "below": <level>}}. The answer then holds the named quantities in decimals at the recorded steps, each one's minimum and maximum over every landed step with its step, its time (the step times dt_s) and every other listed quantity at that step (at_minimum, at_maximum), and first_past when asked. With record_every equal to the steps, one state is recorded and the readout gives the extremes of every step. Not part of the sealed request: the run_seal is that of the same run without it, and the receipt covers it.

first_past.description: A quantity of the list and one of above or below: the first landed step at which it is strictly above (or below) that level, with its time, its value and every other listed quantity at that step (at_step); null when no landed step passes it.

quantities.description: Names of numbers the card publishes in its state; one component of a 3-vector is written name[0], name[1] or name[2].

record_every.description: A state is recorded at each multiple of record_every and at the last landed step, about 262 characters each on the full wire; the final state comes back in full whatever is recorded.

segments.description: A segment may carry signed beside its load: an instrument's Ed25519 signature over the load (alg, key, instrument, time, seq, prev, challenge, sig), verified before computing and covered by the seal. One that does not verify is refused as LoadSignatureDoesNotVerify, a field of the wrong form as LoadSignatureMalformed, an alg other than "ed25519" as LoadSignatureAlgorithmNotServed, and a plan or search that would set a signed value as SignedLoadReplaced. The bytes an instrument signs are given at https://zerotrustphysics.com/docs/. Every run answer carries load_source, which says where each load came from: the number the request states, or a signed reading and its key.

load.description: The load fields of the card for this segment, and no other key. describe_card gives them, with each unit and bound.

signed.description: An instrument's Ed25519 signature over this reading, by the rule run_trajectory's input schema gives at segments.

name: run_trajectory
title: Run trajectory
